name: KiForge
description: Export Gerbers, BOM, CPL, STEP, 3D, SVG, PDF, and HTML BOM from KiCad 10 in one click.
description_full: KiCad 10 manufacturing exporter — Gerbers, drills, BOM, placement, STEP, 3D, SVG, PDF, and HTML BOM from Studio or CLI. Generates GitHub and Gitea release workflows for your project: on each version tag release, KiForge action exports all files and uploads them as release assets.
